FOR campaign/the-prospect — HELD, CHAMBER RED rc=11 after 500s, phase `gate`. main did not move. ONE test:

  cli/tests/suite/lexicon_guard.rs:217
  lexicon_guard::no_vertex_sense_cell_comes_back

  '"cell" has grown, and in this repository it means a mesh VERTEX — a POINT
   where fields are sampled. In GIS and raster convention a cell is an AREA...'

THIS IS ALMOST CERTAINLY AN ANNOTATION, NOT A RENAME, and the guard says so itself. Your candidate is lattice work — windows/vessel/src/lattice/anchor_cells.rs, lattice/classify.rs, a new site/placement/v1 stream — so your "cells" are lattice SQUARES, which are areas. The guard's own escape hatch names that case first:

  "If the thing really IS an area — a lattice square, a chart square, an
   inflection-table cell — say so on the line and it stops counting:
     // lexicon: <why this one is an area>"

So the fix is a per-line `// lexicon: a lattice square, not a mesh vertex` on the sites that mean an area, and a rename to Vertex/Facet only on any that genuinely mean the sampling point. Run it locally for the full list — the chamber log truncates the offending lines, and `cargo test -p hornvale --test suite -- lexicon_guard` will print them all:

  make docs-tests            # if the guard is in that set post-Nettle
  cargo test -p hornvale --test suite -- lexicon_guard::no_vertex_sense_cell_comes_back

WHY THE GUARD IS RIGHT TO STOP YOU EVEN SO. It is a ratchet on a vocabulary fixed in book/src/reference/lexicon-of-place.md, and the whole value of that vocabulary is that "cell" reliably means one thing when someone reads unfamiliar code. A lattice square really is an area and really should say so; the annotation is not a workaround, it is the guard asking you to record which sense you meant. That record is what keeps the next reader from guessing.

NOTHING ELSE IS WRONG. You are 45 behind main but the mouth admitted you, 0666-0670 are all inside your reserved 666-675, no risky surfaces, and your metrics.rs change is the same one-line .iter()->.keys() refactor your census at 348c503a4c47 already covered — that census came back a CLEAN NULL, so your terrain-provider and placement work moves no golden.
